retrieval_query_or_filters: Metadata-only review of ISC-GEM version 12.1 dated 27 November 2025. No catalogue CSV/KMZ bytes were acquired.
intended_use: Homogeneous global instrumental earthquake catalogue reference for seismic-hazard validation, historical event selection and cross-checking earthquake source/event semantics. It is not a ground-motion field, damage catalogue or insured-loss dataset.

licensing.terms_version_or_date: ISC-GEM download/legal page for catalogue version 12.1, reviewed 2026-08-10
licensing.attribution_requirements: Provide attribution required by CC BY-SA 3.0 and cite the ISC-GEM catalogue/DOI as specified by ISC.
licensing.share_alike_or_derivative_requirements: Adapted material/database use remains subject to the CC BY-SA 3.0 share-alike conditions described by the provider, including applicable neighbouring/database rights.
licensing.notes: The authoritative ISC download/legal page states that version 12.1 is available under CC BY-SA 3.0 Unported and explicitly addresses database/neighbouring rights. This engineering review does not interpret a downstream transformation as escaping those conditions.

redistribution.conditions: Source rights allow use/redistribution under CC BY-SA 3.0 subject to attribution and share-alike conditions. OpenCatastrophe approves metadata only; no catalogue file is admitted.

privacy.notes: The reviewed scientific catalogue contains earthquake-event parameters, not person-level or confidential insured information.

spatial.crs: geographic earthquake locations; exact coordinate semantics are defined by the catalogue

temporal.extent: Global instrumental catalogue extending through 2021 in version 12.1; historical completeness varies by time, region and magnitude

variables_and_units.name: origin time
variables_and_units.description: Reviewed earthquake origin-time field; exact precision and uncertainty must be preserved from the catalogue.

variables_and_units.name: hypocentre
variables_and_units.description: Earthquake latitude/longitude and depth with source-specific uncertainty/quality fields.

variables_and_units.name: magnitude
variables_and_units.description: Preferred/homogenized magnitude information, including moment magnitude where available or derived according to ISC-GEM methods.

review.notes: Metadata-only approval for exact version 12.1. The main and supplementary catalogues have different uncertainty semantics and must not be silently merged. Future raw work must select exact files, preserve catalogue fields/uncertainties/licence and record hashes outside Git.
